meta.title: feat: optimize Prisma queries by replacing findFirst with findUnique where applicable
meta.body_summary: Systematically replace findFirst/findFirstOrThrow with findUnique/findUniqueOrThrow on queries using unique indexes, excluding API and test files, to leverage database unique constraints for better performance and type safety.

perf_labels.notes: Devin systematically replaced findFirst with findUnique on unique-key queries across 162 non-API/non-test files; merged after maintainer manually verified all Prisma queries and CI passed.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 859 changed lines across 162 files, this is a medium-sized systematic refactor by absolute volume. It fits a broad but mechanical performance improvement that merged after maintainer manual verification and CI success.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer ThyMinimalDev manually checked all the Prisma queries and found Devin did a good job; no performance evidence requested.
review_details.performance_claim: Replacing findFirst with findUnique for unique-key queries improves database performance via unique index lookups.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Systematic Prisma query optimization is well within Devin's capability when targeting known ORM patterns; merge succeeded due to thorough maintainer manual review and no breaking changes.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer manually reviewed all changed Prisma queries across 162 files.
detection_detail.ci_auto: Type checking and 2041 tests passed; E2E results provided by github-actions.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after performance measurement; only narrative claim of O(1) lookup benefit.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions reported; CI and manual review confirmed correctness.

core_change_summary.description: Across 162 non-API and non-test files, replaced Prisma calls: findFirst → findUnique and findFirstOrThrow → findUniqueOrThrow where WHERE clause uses unique constraints (primary keys, email, composite keys). Reverted API-related and test files per maintainer request.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: All changes were direct query method replacements; no observability additions. Test files were excluded from optimization.
